pages.ja:
部屋に戻ってくる。
少女は重い足取りでベッドまで歩き、とすん、と力なく腰を下ろした。
pages.jaRuby:
部屋に戻ってくる。

pages.en:
She returns to her room.

The girl trudges to the bed and sinks onto it with a soft thump, all her strength gone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The girl returns to her room.
She walks with heavy steps to her bed and sits on it.

pages.ja:
「……先輩。あんな怪我をしたのに、まだ」
何があったのかは知らない。
ただ、少年はたった数時間で絶食したかのようにやつれ、体中に傷を負っていた。
数日前、突然この家に現れた金髪の少女も帰ってこない。
その状況だけで何か取り返しのつかないことが起きたのは明白だ。
少年は何かを隠し、金髪の少女はその結果帰ってこなくなった。

pages.en:
“…Shirou. Even after being hurt that badly, you still…”

She does not know what happened.

She knows only that in the space of a few hours, the boy came back gaunt as though he had fasted for days, his entire body covered in wounds.

The blond girl who appeared in this house without warning several days ago has not come back at all.

That alone makes it plain that something irreversible has happened.

The boy is hiding something, and because of it, the blond girl will not return.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……Senpai. He’s so badly injured, and still…”
She doesn’t know what happened.
The boy looked as lifeless as a starving man, and his body was covered with wounds.
The golden-haired girl who first appeared here several days ago has not returned.
From this, she can tell something has happened that can never be undone.
The boy is hiding something, and the golden-haired girl will not return as a result.

pages.ja:
「………………」
が、そんな事はどうでもいい。
彼女にとって、そんな事はどうでもいいのだ。
何が起きたかは知らないが、少年さえ無事でいるのならそれでいい。
彼女にとっては、衛宮士郎が帰ってきてくれる事に勝る喜びはない。

pages.en:
“………………”

But none of that matters.

To her, none of it matters at all.

She does not know what happened, but as long as the boy is safe, that is enough.

For her, there is no greater happiness than having Shirou Emiya come home.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
But such things don’t matter.
For her, such things are trivial.
She doesn’t know what happened, but it’s fine as long as the boy is safe.
For her, having Emiya Shirou come home is an unparalleled joy.

pages.ja:
「……あれ……今日、冷えるのかな……」
寒気を覚えて額に手を当てる。
……熱い。
体は熱を帯びて、気をしっかり持っていないと倒れてしまいそうだ。
軽い風邪だろうか。
流行り病にはかからない少女にしては珍しいが、何しろ三時間近く廊下で待ち続けていたのだ。体調を崩すのは当然である。

pages.en:
“…Oh… Is it cold tonight…?”

A chill runs through her, and she presses a hand to her forehead.

…Hot.

Her body is burning. If she does not hold herself together, she feels as though she might collapse.

Perhaps it is only a mild cold.

That would be unusual for a girl who never catches whatever is going around, but she did spend almost three hours waiting in the hallway. It would be no surprise if it had made her ill.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……Wait… is it cold today…?”
She shivers and brings her hand up to her forehead.
…It’s hot.
Her body is burning up, and she has to fight to remain conscious.
It must be a light cold.
She rarely gets sick, but after waiting in the hallway for nearly three hours, it’s hardly a surprise.

pages.ja:
「…………、ん……」
だるい体に鞭を打って電気を消す。
着替えるだけの余力はなく少女はぼすん、とベッドに倒れ込んだ。

pages.en:
“…………Nn…”

She forces her leaden body to move long enough to turn out the light.

Without even the strength to change clothes, the girl drops heavily onto the bed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“………Mm…”
With sluggish movements, she reaches over and turns off the light.
She lets herself fall to the bed, lacking even the energy to change clothes.

pages.ja:
「……大丈夫。こんなの、先輩に比べたらぜんぜんだし
」
うつ伏せになったまま、少女は数分前の光景を思い返す。
……おろし金をかけられたような背中。
……重い鈍器で叩かれ、真っ黒に腫れたお腹の痣。
……心身共に傷ついていたのに、やっぱり少しも曇っていなかった強い眼差し。

“…I'm all right. This is nothing next to what happened to Shirou——”

Still lying facedown, the girl recalls the scene from a few minutes ago.

…His back, raw as though someone had raked a grater across it.

…The bruise on his stomach, swollen black from the blow of some heavy, blunt weapon.

…And though both body and heart had been wounded, the strength in his eyes remained utterly undimmed.

…His

pages.ja:
思い返した瞬間、どくん、と体温が上がってしまった。
それが昂揚ではなく憎しみによるものだと、少女は気付かないフリをする。

pages.en:
The instant she remembers, her pulse pounds and her temperature surges.

The girl pretends not to notice that the heat comes not from excitement, but from hatred.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Who could do such a thing?”
…Yes.
She doesn’t know who did it, but she can’t forgive this person.
It’s not temporary dislike or annoyance.
He has been wounded all this time, but he has stayed beautiful.
She cannot forgive anyone that hurts someone important to her.

pages.ja:
「……いったい、誰があんな」
……そう。
誰かは知らないが、彼をあそこまで傷つけた誰かが許せない。
憎いとか嫌いとか、そういう一時的な感情ではない。
あの人はずっと傷ついてきたのに、今まで綺麗なままここにいてくれた。
その、自分なんかとは違う大切な存在を傷つけるモノは、誰であろうと許さない。

pages.en:
“…Who could have done that to him…?”

…Yes.

She does not know who it was, but she will never forgive whoever hurt him so badly.

This goes beyond anything as fleeting as hatred or dislike.

He has been hurt all his life, yet through it all he has remained here beside her, beautiful and unmarred.

He is precious in a way she could never be. Whoever harms him, whoever they may be, will have no forgiveness from her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hm… but… Senpai’s back was amazing…”
She reaches out her hand in a daze.
…It’s been a while since she last saw his naked skin so close.
When they first met, he was small for a boy and was about as tall as her.
But in the two years since then, he has grown into a man.

「ん……けど……先輩の背中、すごかったな……」

初めて会った時は男の子にしては小柄で、自分とあまり背が変わらなかった。
それがここ二年で急速に『男の人』になりつつある。

Still lying down, she stretches out a hand without quite knowing why.

…It has been a long time since she saw the boy's bare skin from so close.

When they first met, he was small for a boy, scarcely taller than she was.

But over the last two years, he has been growing into a man with startling speed.

”

Trapped between her body and the bed, her hand slowly creeps down between her legs.

It’s different from when he collapsed from a cold.
Back then, it was a cold and nothing more.
Tonight, it was the body of a wounded man.

It was different when the boy collapsed with a cold.

That had been nothing more than illness.

It was nothing like the wounded body she saw tonight——the body of a man.

Senpai.”

He must train without a day’s rest. His body is sturdily built, without even an ounce of useless muscle.
His graceful build is like that of an antelope. It has the beauty of having inner strength, one that allows it to jump up precipices, that is not apparent.

“——Shirou.”

Her mind grows hazy as she remembers.

He cannot have neglected his training for a single day. The muscle he has built carries no waste, and stripped bare, he was startlingly strong.

If she had to compare his lithe build to an animal, it would be a mountain antelope: small and unassuming, yet possessed of the grace to race up a sheer cliff.

“Yes… and his chest was so broad. He was… so much a man——”

Her outstretched finger traces the chest that is not there.

It glides over his imagined body without conscious direction, like a bead of water.

From his chest to the hollow of his throat.

Across the sheet, from his throat toward his lips——

“————Ah.”

Her whole face flares scarlet.

It shouldn’t be this embarrassing, but her memory is too vivid.
The feel of his skin beneath her fingertips only made her imagination more concrete.

“Idiot…!”

She jerks her arm back.

Red to the tips of her ears, the girl curls into a ball upon the bed.

It should not have embarrassed her so badly, but the memory in her fingertips is too vivid now.

Those fingers were touching the boy only moments ago, and now they summon the imagined sensation more clearly than ever.

“…Shirou.”

She curls those fingers into a tight fist.

She sinks into the heat suffusing her face, her fingers, her entire body.

Her mind can hold only one thought.

She draws her fist to her chest as though embracing the sensation lingering in her fingertips.

“…Shirou……………”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Mm…… Ah, ah
”
It’s too late to stop.
…Her body is hot.
Her mind is in a daze, and she can only think of one thing.
Her limbs are heavy, and it feels as if she has turned into a puppet.
“Hah… Hm, ah… Ah, mm… Fuh
”
…Her breaths are unbelievably hot.
Is it because the heat is escaping from her body?
The heat invades her brain and melts her memory, intelligence, reason, and morals, making her think of only one thing.
“Ah, hah… Senpai… Hm…”
The heat takes over her body, and the limbs are out of her control.
But dirty desire creeps up from within her.
“…Senpai.”
She clenches her fingers tightly.
Her face, fingers and body grow feverish.
She can only think of one thing.
She brings her fist up to her chest, as if embracing the sensation remaining in her fingertips.
“…Senpai……”

His wounded body. The thought of the blood on his back alone makes her dizzy.

The girl who will never return. What she has taken back. All the lies she has told.

Dark feelings she could never have imagined in her ordinary self twist her into something more distorted, threatening to awaken the joy buried at the bottom of her heart——
